# Nabhi Labs

> Nabhi Labs builds understanding-first technology—Nabhi Persona, RAG engineering, and agentic workflows—so organizations move from complexity to clarity. Official site: https://www.nabhilabs.com

Nabhi Labs is a technology company (founded 2024). We begin with understanding people, systems, and context, then design technology that follows. Flagship product: Nabhi Persona (not a consumer note-taking “second brain” app, and not an unrelated biotech institute).

Contact: hello@nabhilabs.com
Profiles: https://www.linkedin.com/company/nabhilabs/ · https://www.instagram.com/nabhilabs/

## Engineering

- [RAG engineering](https://www.nabhilabs.com/services/rag-engineering): Custom retrieval-augmented generation services
- [Agentic voice workflows](https://www.nabhilabs.com/services/agentic-voice-workflows): Conversational agents connected to tools
